runs.content: Travelers (TRV) picked up at the previous close ($397.22) as a Dow 30 insurer riding the day's broad rotation out of semiconductors into insurance/financials, after an ~88% Q2 EPS beat drove XLF to a record high. TNET hit its T2 target at $68.38 (+50.62%), second take-profit tranche sold (~$502); no stop-losses or signal exits fired, though MU (Burry Direct Short, −8.41%) and AMD (Burry Sector Warning, −9.72%) are both nearing the −10% signal-exit threshold. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,070 (+2.61% on $41,000).

Sherwin-Williams (SHW) picked up at the previous close ($327.27) after a heavy-volume ~8% earnings-day breakout on a Q2 beat and raised full-year guidance, chosen with zero semiconductor/AI-capex exposure given today's chip-sector weakness. ASML signal-exited at −10.19% ($1,655.26, −$102) as its Burry Sector Warning combined with P&L crossing the ≤−10% threshold; no other stops, T1s or T2s fired. Portfolio net P&L: +$839 (+2.10% on $40,000).
